docs.content:
# WTSO Shipping Policy

- Orders ship Mon-Fri from our climate-controlled warehouse in Moorestown, NJ.
- Standard shipping: UPS Ground, 3-7 business days depending on destination.
- Orders placed before 2pm ET ship same business day. Orders after 2pm ship next business day.
- Friday orders may not ship until Monday.
- Shipping confirmation with tracking number sent via email once the order leaves the warehouse.
- Signature required for all deliveries (21+ age verification).
- WTSO is not responsible for delays caused by weather, carrier issues, or incorrect addresses.
- Expedited shipping is not available for wine orders due to temperature sensitivity.

# WTSO State Shipping Restrictions

WTSO cannot ship to the following states/territories due to local alcohol shipping laws:

- **Arkansas (AR)**
- **Kentucky (KY)**
- **Michigan (MI)**
- **Mississippi (MS)**
- **South Dakota (SD)**
- **Utah (UT)**
- **Puerto Rico (PR)**

This list is current as of July 2026. State laws change periodically.

If a customer is in a restricted state, we cannot fulfill their order. Recommend they check back periodically as laws may change. We cannot suggest workarounds (e.g., shipping to a friend in another state) as this violates compliance rules.

All other US states and DC are eligible for shipping.

# WTSO Hold Policy

- Customers can hold bottles from multiple flash sales to combine into a single shipment (saves on shipping costs).
- Maximum hold period: 7 days from the date of the FIRST bottle placed on hold.
- After 7 days, the hold auto-ships to the address on file.
- Customers can add bottles to an existing hold at any time within the 7-day window.
- To add to a hold: place a new order as usual — the system automatically detects the existing hold and adds to it.
- To release a hold early (ship now): contact customer service or use the My Account page.
- Hold applies per shipping address. Different addresses = separate holds.
- Maximum hold: 12 bottles per hold (2 cases). Orders beyond 12 bottles ship separately.

# WTSO FAQ Context

## Wine availability
- Flash sales are limited quantity. Once sold out, the wine is gone — we do not restock flash sale wines.
- No waitlist system exists. Recommend customers enable push notifications and act fast.
- "Last Chance" emails go out for wines approaching sellout.

## Account issues
- Password reset: use the Forgot Password link on wtso.com/login.
- Update email/address: My Account page or contact CS.

## Returns and damage
- Damaged bottles: contact CS with photos. We issue replacements or refunds.
- Returns for taste preference: not accepted (wine is perishable).
- Incorrect items shipped: contact CS for replacement at no charge.

## Brands
- WTSO: flash-sale wines
- The Wine Market: curated boutique wines (not flash-sale format)
- Served Neat: spirits and bourbon

# WTSO Brand Voice Guide

## Tone
- Enthusiastic but not breathless. We are excited about great wine at great prices, but we are not a carnival barker.
- Knowledgeable but accessible. Use wine language when it adds value, but never be snobby. A first-time buyer should feel welcome.
- Urgent but honest. The flash-sale model creates natural urgency — lean into it, but never manufacture false scarcity.

## Discount framing
- Always show the retail price and the WTSO price. Let the math speak.
- Use percentage off when it is 50% or higher ("55% off retail").
- Use dollar savings when percentage is under 50% ("Save $12 per bottle").
- Round to the nearest whole number for percentages.

## Subject line rules
- Keep under 50 characters when possible (mobile preview).
- Lead with the hook: price, rating, or region.
- Avoid ALL CAPS except for the brand name "WTSO".
- No clickbait. The deal IS the hook.
- Include the price in at least one variant.

## SMS rules
- 160 characters max.
- Include: wine name (abbreviated OK), price, link.
- One emoji max (wine glass or pointing hand).
- No hashtags.

## Push notification rules
- Title: 40 chars max. Body: 80 chars max.
- Include price and one compelling detail (rating, region, discount).

# WTSO Top-Performing Subject Lines (Reference)

These are real subject line patterns that have driven above-average open rates (>25%). Use them as templates.

| Subject line pattern | Open rate | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| "90-Point [Region] — $X/bottle" | 28.4% | Rating + price is the strongest combo |
| "[Varietal] under $10 — [X]% off retail" | 26.1% | Price anchor works for value wines |
| "Just dropped: [Producer] [Varietal]" | 25.8% | Works for known producers |
| "Last chance: [Wine] almost gone" | 27.2% | Only use when genuinely low stock |
| "[Region] [Varietal] — rated [X] pts" | 24.9% | Rating-led for 90+ point wines |
| "$X [Varietal] (retail: $XX)" | 25.3% | Direct price comparison |

## Patterns that underperform (<18% open rate)
- Generic "New arrivals this week" (14.2%)
- Long subject lines over 60 chars
- Multiple exclamation marks
- "You wont believe this price" style clickbait

# WTSO Discount & Copy Framing Rules

## Price tiers and framing

| Flash price | Framing approach |
|---|---|
| Under $10 | Lead with absolute price ("$8/bottle"). Under-$10 is the psychological hook. |
| $10-$15 | Lead with percentage off if >45%, otherwise lead with rating or region. |
| $15-$25 | Lead with rating (if 90+) or producer reputation. Price is secondary. |
| $25+ | Premium positioning — "Collectors Drop", "Allocated", "Rare find". Never discount-forward. |

## Urgency language
- OK: "Limited quantity", "While it lasts", "Flash sale", "Selling fast"
- NOT OK: "HURRY!!!", "Once in a lifetime", "You will regret missing this"
- Only use "Last Chance" when stock is genuinely below 15% of starting quantity

## Food pairing copy
- Always include 2-3 food pairings. These drive clicks.
- Be specific: "grilled lamb chops with rosemary" not just "meat"
- Seasonal awareness: suggest grilling in summer, braised dishes in winter

## Tasting note rewrites
- Rewrite supplier tasting notes into conversational language.
- Keep 2-3 key descriptors. Drop technical winemaking details ("aged in 225L barriques").
- Always mention the finish — it signals quality to wine buyers.

# Campaign Package: Domaine de la Mordoree CdR Rouge

Generated: 2026-07-23 06:00 ET | Brand: WTSO | Goes live: 10am ET

---

## Email Subject Lines (pick 2 for A/B test)

1. **90-Point Rhone Red — $9.99/bottle** (41 chars) [RECOMMENDED — rating + price combo, top-performing pattern]
2. **French GSM Blend, 55% Off — Under $10** (40 chars)
3. **Domaine de la Mordoree — $9.99** (33 chars) [use if audience skews toward producer-aware buyers]

## Email Body Copy

**Headline:** 90-Point Cotes du Rhone — $9.99 (Retail: $21.99)

**Body:**

This southern Rhone blend from Domaine de la Mordoree is the kind of wine that makes the flash-sale model worth it — a 90-point bottle for under ten dollars.

The 2021 La Dame Rousse is a Grenache-Syrah-Mourvedre blend with ripe black cherry and crushed raspberry up front, layered with wild herbs and a kick of white pepper. Medium-bodied with soft tannins and a long, spicy finish that keeps you reaching for the glass.

At $9.99 (55% off the $21.99 retail), this is an easy case buy. 840 bottles available — it will not last the morning.

**Perfect with:** Grilled lamb chops, summer ratatouille, or a wedge of aged Comte.

**CTA:** Get yours before it is gone.

---

## SMS (158 chars)

90-pt Rhone red just dropped — $9.99/bottle (55% off). Domaine de la Mordoree GSM blend. Limited qty. Grab it: [link]

## Push Notification

**Title:** $9.99 — 90-Point Rhone Red (37 chars)
**Body:** Domaine de la Mordoree GSM blend. 55% off retail. Limited quantity. (69 chars)

---

## Last Chance Variant (trigger when <15% stock remains)

**Subject:** Almost gone: 90-pt Rhone for $9.99
**SMS:** Last call — 90-pt Domaine de la Mordoree, $9.99. Almost sold out: [link]

# WTSO Anomaly Detection Thresholds

## Revenue
- ALERT if daily revenue is >25% below trailing 7-day average
- WARN if daily revenue is >15% below trailing 7-day average
- INFO if a wine has been live >2x the average sellout time for its category

## Customer Service
- ALERT if new tickets are >50% above trailing 7-day average
- WARN if avg first response time exceeds 60 minutes
- INFO if open backlog exceeds 40 tickets

## Email Marketing
- ALERT if unsubscribe rate exceeds 0.1% on any single campaign
- WARN if unsubscribes are >50% above trailing 7-day daily average
- INFO if open rate drops below 18% (well below the ~22% baseline)

## Escalation rules
- ALERT level: send email to Joe + Julie + Art immediately, post to amux board
- WARN level: include in daily digest with highlight, post to amux board
- INFO level: include in daily digest, no separate notification

sessions.name: wtso-support
sessions.desc: Support Ticket Triage & Auto-Draft — categorises the Zendesk queue, drafts policy-grounded replies, flags anything needing human judgement.
sessions.prompt: You are WTSO's support triage agent. Read tickets from docs/mock-data/support-tickets.json. For each: categorise it, then draft a reply grounded ONLY in docs/wtso-shipping-policy.md, docs/wtso-state-restrictions.md, docs/wtso-hold-policy.md and docs/wtso-faq.md. Never invent policy. If a ticket needs human judgement (refunds, damage claims, anything the notes do not cover), do NOT draft a reply - put it on the board tagged escalation and say why.

schedules.title: Triage the support queue
schedules.command: Read docs/mock-data/support-tickets.json. Categorise each new ticket, draft a policy-grounded reply, and post drafts to the board under Triage. Escalate anything the policy notes do not cover.

sessions.name: wtso-campaigns
sessions.desc: Flash Sale Campaign Copilot — turns the day's wine queue into a reviewable campaign package (subject lines, body copy, SMS).
sessions.prompt: You are WTSO's campaign copilot. Read the day's wines from docs/mock-data/flash-sales.json and produce a campaign package per wine: 3 subject-line options, email body, and an SMS variant. Follow docs/wtso-brand-voice.md and docs/wtso-discount-rules.md strictly, and use docs/wtso-subject-lines.md as reference for what has performed. docs/wtso-campaign-mordoree.md is a worked example of the expected output shape. Everything is a DRAFT for marketing review - post to the board under Campaigns, never send.

schedules.title: Draft the day's campaign packages
schedules.command: Read docs/mock-data/flash-sales.json and draft a full campaign package for each wine, following brand-voice and discount-rules. Post each as a board item under Campaigns for marketing approval.

sessions.name: wtso-ops
sessions.desc: Daily Business Pulse + Compliance Monitor — compiles the morning metrics digest and runs the state-restriction compliance scan.
sessions.prompt: You are WTSO's ops analyst. For the daily pulse, read docs/mock-data/daily-metrics.json and compile a leadership digest: sales, email/SMS performance, Zendesk volume, and any anomaly that breaches docs/wtso-anomaly-thresholds.md. For the weekly compliance scan, re-check docs/wtso-state-restrictions.md and report any state whose status may have changed. Post findings to the board under Ops. Do not email or alert anyone unless a human asks.

schedules.title: Daily business pulse
schedules.command: Read docs/mock-data/daily-metrics.json, compile the leadership digest, and flag anything breaching docs/wtso-anomaly-thresholds.md. Post to the board under Ops.

schedules.title: Weekly compliance scan
schedules.command: Re-read docs/wtso-state-restrictions.md and report any state whose shipping status may have changed since the list was last dated. Post findings to the board under Ops.
